finding.description: Dashboard OutcomeClosure projection accepted Python numeric values without rejecting NaN or positive/negative Infinity. Non-finite values are not portable canonical JSON numbers and can break deterministic replay, equality, sorting, aggregation or cross-runtime owner-visible interpretation.

repair.rule: Every projected outcome numeric metric must be a finite int/float after normalization. bool, nested/non-numeric, NaN and +/-Infinity fail closed.
unchanged_invariants: trust remains UNKNOWN_UNVERIFIED or REFERENCE_BOUND_UNVERIFIED only

authored_adversarial_tests: +Infinity rejected for every outcome numeric field
-Infinity rejected for every outcome numeric field
threshold_policy: NO_NEW_COGNITIVE_THRESHOLD; existing presentation bounds remain TEST_REQUIRED
quantum_independent_review_requested: Confirm fail-closed handling of non-finite numbers is sufficient for canonical dashboard projection.
Review whether signed zero, extreme-but-finite magnitudes, decimal canonicalization or numeric precision require a separately versioned projection policy.
Confirm this UI-layer finite-number repair cannot be treated as OutcomeClosure trust/eligibility authority.
